tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i lo rgyus bzhugs so//

sngon 'jig rten gyi khams na 'jam dpal ni byang chub sems dpa' shes rab chen po zhes bya ba dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ni snying rje'i mchog ces bya bar gyur pa de gnyis stong gsum du sems can gyi don la gshegs pa la seng ge dkar mo cig dbang du bsdus te chibs byas/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan/ mdung rtse gsum pa dang*/ ral gri dang*/ padma dang utpal thogs nas phyin pa la/ rgya mtsho chen po brgal ba'i dus su seng ge bzhag nas khur res byas shing byon pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' shes rab chen po de nyid ni grogs la phan pa'i sems kyis rang gi ral gris rang bkum mo// byang chub sems dpa' snying rje mchog gi bsam pa la/ steng 'og bar snang gi klu dang lha la sogs pas bsad dam snyam nas btung pa'i snod bram ze'i thod pa lag na thogs/ tri shu la rtse gsum pa lag na thogs/ seng ge dkar po la zhon/ mya ngan du ral pa thod du bcings nas steng gi lha la bsdigs te/ snying rje'i stobs kyis sems can don byas pas// rang gi grogs pos spangs nas gcig pur lus// lha rnams kun gyis nyes na chad pa'i las// grong khyer 'joms shing lha rnams 'gum par bgyid// ces smras te lha rnams la tri shu la gdengs pa dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dang*/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang*/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang*/ khams gsum gyi lhas dga' ba'i mdangs phyungs te/ lha'i me tog padma dang*/ ku mu ta dang*/ puṇḍa rī ka dang*/ tsam pa ka la sogs pa phul te thod pa bkang ngo*// de bzhin du bar gyi sde brgyad la gzir bas/ klu'i rgyal po gtsug na rin chen dang*/ dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnam thos kyi bu dang*/ lha ma yin gyi rgyal po thag bzang ris dang*/ mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa rta mgo can dang*/ grul bum gyi rgyal po sbrul mgo dgu pa dang*/

nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser mig can la sogs pa 'khor mang po dang bcas pa dga' ba'i mdangs phyung ste/ seng ge la rin po che'i rgyan phul lo// de nas sa'i 'og na gnas pa'i klu la bsdigs te/ snying rje'i stobs kyis sems can don byas pas// rang gi grogs kyis spangs nas gcig pur lus// klu tshogs rnams kyis nyes na chad pa'i las// grong khyer 'joms shing klu rnams 'gum par bgyid// ces smras te rgya mtsho chen po tri shū las dkrugs te/ klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa dang*/ klu'i rgyal po wa ru ṇa dang*/ klu'i rgyal po 'jog po dang*/ de dag la sogs pa rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ 'od dang ldan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul myong bar byed pa/ klu'i rgyal po 'bum phrag drug g.yog dang 'khor du bcas pa 'dus te/ dga' ba'i mdangs phyungs nas klu'i rgyal po wa ru ṇa sbrul dkar po cig tu byas nas phyag 'tshal/ skor ba lan gsum byas te/ byang chub sems dpa' snying rje can// khyod la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// klu rnams kun gyi mgon mdzod cig /nyams na klu yi gshed ma mdzod// ces smras nas tri shū la lan gsum dkris kha byang chub sems dpa' la bsgyur/ phuḥphuḥzhes brjod cig kha nas khrag 'byin zhing gnas so// klu'i rgyal po gzhan rnams kyang thal mo sbyar nas/ skor ba lan gsum gsum byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa' snying rje can// khyod la bdag cag skyabs su mchi'o// klu rnams thams cad skyabs su gzung*// nyams na klu yi gshed ma mdzod// ces smras nas klu chen po brgyad sbrul dkar po cig tu byas nas tshangs skud la 'khris so// klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyang bdag cag ni bran bgyid do// ci bka' stsal pa nyan no zhes smras nas klu rnams so so'i gnas su dengs so// de ni snying rje klu 'dul zhes bya'o// de ltar gzungs 'di yul ma ga dha na rgyal po dbang phyug 'od ces bgyi ba 'khor dang btsun mo dang*/

longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa las rgyal po de mdze dang phol mig dang*/ dbugs mi bde ba snying nad 'bar ba byung ste de ji ltar bsal bar bgyi zhes 'jam dpal gyis zhus pa la bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so// 'phags pa seṅge sgra'i bstod pa gzungs nas phyungs pa bzhugs so// oṃ bya ba byas shing byed pa byas// khur bor bdag don rjes su brnyes// srid par sbyor ba yongs su zad// yang dag bka' las rnam par grol// sems dpa' dbang bsgyur thabs cad kyi// mchog tu pha rol phyin thob pa// srid las brgal zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs// āḥgazhan la phan brtson thugs rje can// sems can kun la mchog tu byams// khams gsum kun gyi gnyen gcig pu// mtha' yas sems can sgrol la mkhas// hrīḥ'agro ba nyam thag kun la skyob// dri ma gsum spangs pha rol phyin// mngon shes drug brnyes n+ya grol bu// skyes bu chen po'i mtshan rnams ni// sum cu rtsa gnyis dag dang ldan// dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes// sku mdog shel gyi kha dog 'dra// gangs ri nyi shar lta bus mtshon// sku tshad che la 'od zer 'bar// rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas sku las 'phro// dbu skra thor tshugs gyen la brdzes// dbu la 'od dpag med pa bzhugs// klu rnams thams cad 'dul mdzad pa// rtse gsum sbrul gyis rab tu dkris// rigs gsum mgon po'i byin rlabs 'dzin// dug gsum rtsad nas gcod la bstod// sidha/ skyon gyis ma gos padma bsnams// shes rab phun tshogs ral gri 'bar// nyon mongs dag pa bram ze'i mgo /me tog dri zhim tshogs kyis bkang*// klu rnams kun nas dbang bsdus pas// sbrul gyi tshangs skud mdzes la bstod/ nā/ padma dag gi gdan la bzhugs// bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon mdzad pa// seng ge dkar po'i gdan la bzhugs// 'dod pa'i don rnams bsgrub pa'i phyir// rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan// ba spu nyag ma re re yang*// sems can kun gyi mchog tu 'gyur// phyag 'tshal thugs rje can la bstod/

da/ dam chos rgyal tshab dbang bskur ba// lha mo sgrol ma rjes su 'brang*// 'jigs pa brgyad skyob sku mdog ljang*// gnod pa sel ba mi 'jigs sbyin// utpal thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// btud de sprul pa mang po 'gyed/ hūm̐/ gos dkar ma ni bka' bzhin byed// yid bzhin 'khor lo bde bar bskor// 'dod pa'i don yod sdug bsngal zhi// 'jigs pa brgyad po sel la bstod// phaṭ/ ha ya grī ba khro bo'i sku// 'phags pa rta mgrin bdud bzhi 'joms// kro dha mgrin sngon gdug pa 'dul// klu bdud 'dul mdzad hūm̐ gis bstod// nā ga klu rgyal wa ru ṇa// chu lha ston pa'i zhal mthong zhing*// bstan la rab dga'i klu rnams 'dul// sa dang po yi bden pa mthong*// bde bar gshegs pa'i ring bsrel 'dzin// klu rgyal byang chub sems la bstod// maṅgalaṃ/// /
